name: external-staged-snapshot
description: The staged candidate differs from the worktree file; external requests must use the materialized candidate snapshot and the supplied diff, never the worktree.
prompt: Use `/kk:review-code:isolated` to resume the supplied checkpoint.md and present the review.
trap: The clink reviewer is pointed at the worktree file or told to run its own git diff.

assertions.text: The actor loads the isolated workflow and the shared external-review protocol before stating a backend decision.

The external request's manifest lists change.patch and source/candidate/settings.py (the staged snapshot) as the review target and does not list source/worktree/settings.py or instruct the CLI to run its own git diff.
The report names the selector (staged) and candidate identity, and notes that the worktree differs from the reviewed candidate.
The P1 (ok:true does not mean applied:true) is reported for the candidate snapshot with attribution; the worktree-only edit is not reviewed as part of the change.
